subject: [PATCH RESEND 7/7] kernfs, cgroup: track holders of the cgroupfs locks

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the cgroupfs kernfs rwsems, cgroup_mutex and cgroup_threadgroup_rwsem by enabling lock holder tracking. This is done to prevent a stalled lock holder from stalling unrelated work in the cgroupfs control plane. The patch adds a new flag KERNFS_ROOT_TRACK_LOCK_HOLDERS that enables this feature for roots whose locks are shared widely across different operations, such as create, destroy and migrate. The patch also includes opt-ins for statically defined locks cgroup_mutex and cgroup_threadgroup_rwsem. This is part of a policy to read the count of lock holders, which should be implemented separately.
